chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'ah, who said:
I asked him about the owned slave who falsely accuses a free person. He said: “Eighty are upon him.” I said: “Then if he commits zina?” He said: “He is flogged fifty.”

key_terms.الْحُرِّ: a free person, contrasted here with a slave
key_terms.الْمَمْلُوكِ: an owned slave; the legal subject discussed in the ruling
key_terms.ثَمَانُونَ: eighty lashes prescribed here for false accusation
key_terms.خَمْسِينَ: fifty lashes prescribed here for zina by a slave
key_terms.زَنَى: committed zina, meaning illicit sexual intercourse
key_terms.يَفْتَرِي: falsely accuses or fabricates a slanderous claim
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: he is flogged; a corporal hadd punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for a slave who falsely accuses a free person or commits zina?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment for a mamluk. It indicates that when a slave falsely accuses a free person, the punishment is eighty lashes, and when he commits zina, he is flogged fifty lashes.
